title: World map and China detail
condition: Rebuild for the chosen cohort and location evidence.

title: Province counts
condition: Use where provenance supports province-level assignment.

title: Site map with regional detail
condition: Requires verified sites and boundary data.

title: Side-by-side marker PCA
condition: Requires paired SNP and SV data for the same individuals.

title: TE PCA by climate zone
condition: Requires climate-zone assignments for the plotted individuals.

title: SNP PCA by climate zone
condition: Requires matched SNP PCA and climate zones.

title: Tree and admixture alignment
condition: Requires a matched tree, ancestry proportions and IDs.

title: Climate context and environment correlations
condition: Requires matched WorldClim rasters and environmental metadata.

title: Ordination, environmental vectors and axis tests
condition: Use component values and scores from a single fitted model.

title: Evidence across association methods
condition: Keep SV–environment pairs and unique SV alleles distinct.

title: TE composition and family enrichment
condition: Requires validated TE annotation and eligible background.

title: Genome-wide Circos with TE structures
condition: Requires a shared reference build and defined density tracks.

title: Association-statistic comparison
condition: Use aligned statistics. Inference requires an appropriate dependence model.

title: Environment-by-method radar
condition: Use a common counting unit and document tested denominators.

title: Association statistics with marginal views
condition: Use summary statistics from matched loci and environments.

title: Niche overlap and a null distribution
condition: Use a documented environmental space and a defined null model.

title: Unique and shared environmental associations
condition: Requires a fixed significance rule and an explicit unit of counting.

title: Isolation by distance and environment
condition: Requires distances, site groups and a permutation design.

title: Climate driver contribution
condition: Requires a defined importance metric and matching fitted model.
